data.name: Spider: Rite of the Shrouded Moon
data.detailed_description:
" A secret society built Blackbird Estate for a specific purpose..
..Not even the family living there today knows what it was."

Web Crafting, Insect Hunting Gameplay

You are a spider on the hunt! Build webs of your own design to trap and eat a wide variety of dynamic insects, each with its own behaviors and vulnerabilities. You must possess the agility and cunning of a spider to master the deep scoring system and top the per-level leaderboards in this unique, innovative blend of action, strategy, and puzzle gameplay.

Your Real World Time and Weather .. Inside The Game!

Prepare to be immersed as never before. Spider uses your location to reflect the time of day and weather in the game with that outside your window. Moths, fireflies, and crickets only come out at night. When it rains in real life, the rain also falls on Blackbird Estate. Play on a stormy night when lightning electrifies the top of the tower, or explore during a full moon when rare moths can be found.

Hours and Months of Replayable Content

Over 30 unique levels, each of which features redesigned gameplay in all 4 conditions, along with shuffled content and multiple areas, leading to countless combinations of challenges, collectibles, environments, secrets to discover, and high scores to master. Collect dozens of insects, multiple spider skins, and 48 achievements of increasing difficulty.

Solve Cryptic Puzzles and Unravel the Mystery

Welcome to Blackbird Estate, an abandoned mansion built long ago by an enigmatic secret society for a mysterious purpose, unknown even to the family who until recently lived here. Use the map to explore the grounds, collecting clues that can be pieced together to open hidden passages, decrypt secret messages, and uncover long-buried secrets. The clues may help you solve the estate's 7 puzzles, but you're on your own when it comes to the ultimate mystery: The Rite of the Shrouded Moon!

A Story of Spider Proportions

What really happened at Blackbird Estate? Slip under the floorboards and through keyholes for a spider's unique perspective on this dramatic story told in the background without text or dialog. Piece together the tattered tale of a mad inventor, a brave child, and an adventurer of the high seas who hides a dark secret. Search for clues at a crime scene, a faulty time machine, and a graveyard full of unexpected surprises.

Two Games In One

Play for high scores and the story won't slow you down. Or if you prefer to solve the mystery, you can ignore the leaderboards entirely. Do both for the greatest challenge, or neither to breeze your way to the exciting conclusion. Spider allows you to seamlessly customize your experience and decide what kind of gameplay you're in the mood for.


The Steam Version features precision aiming mechanics designed for both gamepad and mouse/keyboard, along with a wide, high resolution view, essential tools for topping the leaderboards.

reviews.review:
Where to start ... where to start ... Hmmm ... Let's start with gameplay. Gamer plays as a SPIDER (four different ones plus a WALRUS) so Arachnophobic souls should beware. The entire game play is physics based with the spider creating webs to trap then eat insects, crickets, moths and butterflies. Bees, hornets, dragonflies, and red ants needed to tackled to be consumed. (There are many other insects too, the mentioned are just the most common.) The consumption is converted into silk thread and points. There are five point tiers and some achievements are based on points.

Death: Running out of silk causes starvation death. There are other ways to die but why spoil the experience (or earning that achievement).

Remember I mentioned the 4 different spider species and the WALRUS. Each spider species is revealed after solving a mystery which is a background element to the gameplay and must be completed to continue to the end game. The walrus appears after the fourth mystery is solved but can used from the beginning if a cheat is entered. (To get the walrus change your in-game name to "Rosmarus" in 'Save Sessions' menu then select the walrus in the 'Spider Type' menu.)

Now for the mysteries and clues. There are several mysteries present surrounding the Blackbird Estate. The biggest one would be who are these people and what are they doing. There is a crime, or two, possibly more, and at least one experiment involving a laboratory and electricity on rainy night. There are clues (mostly in hidden cavities and places) the player must find if looking for the main storyline. The main storyline is rather cryptic so subject to interpretation. However, there is probably at least one betrayal, several love affairs, possibly a love triangle, a possible illegitimate child, at least one theft, grave robbery, falsified deaths, possible privacy, illicit experiments and murder.  Plus one secret society that may or may not have anything to do with Blackbird family, though it is heavily implied some family members belong to the Society.  

The underlying mystery of Blackbird Estate is due to a secret society called Knights of the Buried Chambers (probably fictional) and something called the Gazophylacium Subterraneum (which no longer exists). When this game first came out there was a website that led to this place. The website no longer exists. Information still exists concerning it if the player wants to go searching. 

Does the missing website effect gameplay? Not really. I recommend using the guide by Vantablack Pharoah to supply the missing information and answers to the deleted/redacted/missing information to get the 7 hidden achievements related to this information. Other then these achievements the player should be able to get all other achievements and solve the required mysteries with a little skill and some thought. 

Finally necessary "cheats" since without them 100% achievement is impossible. 1) The weather change icon must used to get one achievement and solve one mystery. The location button no longer works so local weather is no longer determined automatically. Day/night cycles and moon phases still work automatically however. 2) The external date calendar of the computer will have to be used to determine solar eclipses. 2 achievements require a solar eclipse on a clear day. (Anyone want to figure that out please make a little guide for it - thanks.) 3) Again please follow the guide by Vantablack Pharoah for Secret Achievements, the ones under spoiler tags since as far as I know this is the only way presently to complete those achievements since the original information to figure them out no longer exists.

Overall, this is a unique physic based game with a little bit adventure, mystery and intrigue. There are 30 different locations, and each location is different with different bugs and challenges depending on day/night cycle and weather. The global high scores make one wonder how they achieved them. There are special conditions to catch certain moths or butterflies.  Moon phases are incredibly important to pay attention to for game completion. 

Worth the price for replay value alone. 48 achievements. No trading cards.
